# code | property
11 | the free count equals the number of clear bits below nframes
12 | every bit at or past nframes in the last word is set
13 | every word below the hint is full
21 | alloc returns the lowest free frame, or PFA_NONE when no frame is free
22 | every operation returns the exact code the tracked state implies
23 | an operation changes exactly the bits it names, and a refused one changes none
24 | conservation: free count plus used count equals nframes after every step
25 | alloc_run is first fit: it returns the lowest start of n free frames in a row
